mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation_event_display (tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_id, dispatch_attempt, event_seq, event_type, status, queue_class, projection_version, attempt_count, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{dispatchAttempt}, #{eventSeq}, #{eventType}, 'PREPARING', #{queueClass}, #{projectionVersion}, 0, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtCreate})
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_event_display SET queue_class = 'LARGE', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, attempt_count = 0, gmt_modified = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND status = 'PREPARING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, turn_id FROM conversation_event_display WHERE status = 'PREPARING' AND queue_class = #{queueClass} AND (turn_id > #{afterTurnId} OR (turn_id = #{afterTurnId} AND id > #{afterId})) AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY turn_id ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.dispatch_attempt, e.event_seq FROM agent_conversation_turn_event e LEFT JOIN conversation_event_display d ON d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND d.conversation_id = e.conversation_id AND d.turn_id = e.turn_id AND d.dispatch_attempt = e.dispatch_attempt AND d.event_seq = e.event_seq WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND e.turn_id = #{turnId} AND d.id IS NULL AND (e.dispatch_attempt > #{afterAttempt} OR (e.dispatch_attempt = #{afterAttempt} AND e.event_seq > #{afterEventSeq})) GROUP BY e.dispatch_attempt, e.event_seq ORDER BY e.dispatch_attempt ASC, e.event_seq ASC LIMIT #{limit}

select.foreach: (SELECT id FROM conversation_event_display WHERE status = 'PREPARING' AND queue_class = #{queueClass} AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at < #{now}) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY turn_id DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM conversation_event_display WHERE status = 'PREPARING' AND queue_class = #{queueClass}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_event_display SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempt_count = CASE WHEN attempt_count < 0 THEN 1 ELSE attempt_count + 1 END, gmt_modified = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PREPARING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})

UPDATE conversation_event_display SET status = 'READY', publication_seq = #{publicationSeq}, summary = #{summary}, content_length = #{contentLength}, total_segments = #{totalSegments}, truncated = #{truncated}, detail_available = #{detailAvailable}, projection_version = #{projectionVersion}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, gmt_modified = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE conversation_event_display SET next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, gmt_modified = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PREPARING' AND attempt_count > 0
UPDATE conversation_event_display SET source_removed = 1, status = 'FAILED', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM conversation_event_display d WHERE d.gmt_create < #{cutoff} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_conversation_turn t WHERE t.id = d.turn_id AND t.tenant_id = d.tenant_id) ORDER BY d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM conversation_event_display WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT high_water_raw_id FROM conversation_event_display_scan WHERE scan_key = 'RAW'
SELECT MAX(id) FROM agent_conversation_turn_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND turn_id = #{turnId}

SELECT e.id FROM agent_conversation_turn_event e LEFT JOIN conversation_event_display d ON d.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND d.conversation_id = e.conversation_id AND d.turn_id = e.turn_id AND d.dispatch_attempt = e.dispatch_attempt AND d.event_seq = e.event_seq WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND e.turn_id = #{turnId} AND d.id IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT scan_key, last_raw_id, high_water_raw_id, generation, quiet_until FROM conversation_event_display_scan WHERE scan_key = #{scanKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO conversation_event_display_scan (scan_key, last_raw_id, high_water_raw_id, generation, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{scanKey}, 0, 0, 0, #{now})
